title: 第13章 警醒族人家族新制度第14章 当众斩首
slug: 开局签到帝经我家族独断万古
lines: 大长老的声音久久不断，而一众林家族人的愤怒也是不曾有一丝一毫的减弱，甚至愈演愈烈。
实在是这些人干的每一件事，都是那么的令人发指，憎恶！
而那些受害族人的亲人朋友，更是直接情绪失控，如果不是此时正是大会进行中，以及一旁的族人拦着，估计他们早就冲上去，将这些家族祸害大卸八块了。
他们可以接受自己的父亲、兄弟、朋友被敌人所害，那样他们只有对敌人的无尽仇恨，只会努力修炼，以后为他们的亲人报仇雪恨！
而不会像如今一般愤怒……
这种最亲之人，被平时与你朝夕相处的族人背叛、杀害的感觉……太痛了……
这种感觉不亲身经历过的，又有谁懂……
而伴随着那撕心裂肺的痛的，还有那无尽的愤怒……
他们一想到这些杀害了他们最亲之人的狗东西，却如平常般和自己相处，蒙骗着自己，那股愤怒就止不住的从心底涌现。
那股愤怒犹如洪水猛兽般，瞬间便淹没了他们的理智。
而不仅下方的那些族人，即使是虚空之上的各位族老和林长霄三位老祖，此时也是不复之前的严肃神情，反而个个眉头紧锁，满脸怒容。
他们此前也只知道有这么一批祸害，但因为当时急于修炼，而且有林天海这位族长亲自处理，他们也很放心，所以并未深入了解这些人都干了什么。
本来他们以为情况不会如此严重恶劣，但如今看来简直是恰恰相反啊。
这些人背叛家族、当敌对势力的奸细、出卖家族信息、以家情报信息牟利、私自贩卖家族资源等，最主要的居然还直接或间接杀害同族之人，以及修炼魔功。
其它还威胁不到家族根本，但修炼魔功这等事，却可能让他林家陷入万劫不复之地！
要知道中州的总体格局，可分为人族正道势力、妖族、魔道势力三方，呈现三足鼎立之势。
而因为魔道功法嗜血残暴，且极易影响心智，魔修更是动不动就是屠城灭族，所以无论是人族正道势力还是妖族，对于魔道的一切可谓是零容忍，一旦发现有谁修炼魔功功法，无论是谁皆是格杀勿论，甚至可能牵连背后势力。
所以如果一旦林家有人修炼魔功的事，被敌对势力别有用心的宣传，大做文章，那林家可就危险了。
那些帝级势力可不会管你是不是被别的势力陷害，他们只相信自己看到的，哪怕这个势力是无辜的又如何？
反正在他们眼中区区一个圣族，蝼蚁而已，灭了便灭了，又不影响中州的总体格局。
大长老的宣读，不断的持续着，而随着时间的推移，他的声音都不由自主的带上了一股怒意。
即使已经看过很多遍，但当他再次看到这些信息，心中的愤怒还是不由自主的涌现。
整个宣读，足足持续了半个时辰，才结束。
至此所有族人也是全部知道了，这些家族祸害的所有所作所为。
content_en:
The great elder's voice continued for a long time, and the anger of the Lin family members never weakened at all, and even intensified.
In fact, everything these people do is so heinous and disgusting!
The relatives and friends of the victimized tribesmen immediately lost control of their emotions. If the conference was not in progress at this time, and the tribesmen on the side stopped them, they would have rushed forward and cut these family scourges into pieces.
They can accept that their fathers, brothers, and friends were harmed by the enemy. Then they will only have endless hatred for the enemy, and they will only work hard to cultivate and avenge their relatives in the future!
Instead of being as angry as now...
This feeling of your dearest being betrayed and killed by the clansman you usually spend time with day and night... is too painful...
Who can understand this feeling if they have not experienced it personally...
And along with the heartbreaking pain, there is also the endless anger...
When they think about these bitches who have killed their dearest people, but they get along with them as usual and deceive themselves, the anger can't stop rising from the bottom of their hearts.
The anger was like a scourge, overwhelming their reason in an instant.
…
Not only the clansmen below, but also the clan elders and the three ancestors Lin Changxiao above the void, now no longer have the serious expressions they had before. Instead, they all have frowns and angry looks on their faces.
They had only known about such a group of scourges before, but because they were eager to practice at that time, and because the patriarch Lin Tianhai personally dealt with it, they were relieved, so they did not have a deep understanding of what these people had done.
Originally they thought that the situation would not be so serious and bad, but now it seems that it is exactly the opposite.
These people betrayed the family, acted as spies for hostile forces, sold family information, profited from family information, sold family resources privately, etc. The most important thing was that they directly or indirectly killed people of the same clan and practiced magic.
Others do not threaten the foundation of the family, but things like practicing magic skills may plunge the Lin family into a situation of eternal disaster!
We must know that the overall structure of Zhongzhou can be divided into three parties: the human race's righteous forces, the demon race, and the demonic forces, showing a tripartite confrontation.
And because the demonic skills are bloodthirsty and cruel, and can easily affect the mind, the demonic cultivators will slaughter cities and exterminate clans at every turn. Therefore, whether it is the righteous forces of the human race or the demon clan, they have zero tolerance for anything in the demonic way. Once anyone is found practicing the demonic skills, they will be killed regardless of who they are, and may even implicate the forces behind them.
Therefore, if someone in the Lin family practices magic skills is publicized and made a big fuss by hostile forces with ulterior motives, then the Lin family will be in danger.
Those emperor-level forces don't care if you are framed by other forces. They only believe what they see. So what if this force is innocent?
Anyway, in their eyes, they are just a holy clan, nothing more than ants. If they are destroyed, they will be destroyed without affecting the overall structure of Zhongzhou.
…
The Great Elder's reading continued, and as time passed, his voice became involuntarily filled with anger.
Even though he had read it many times, when he saw this information again, the anger in his heart still emerged involuntarily.
The entire reading lasted for half an hour before it ended.
At this point, all the clan members know everything that these family scourges have done.
title_en: Chapter 13: Alert the clansmen to the new family system Chapter 14: Beheading in public
